verdict.rationale: Conductor gives each workspace a diff and review path, helps you review the diff before opening a PR, and surfaces PR comments and failing-check logs. Its new routines can run agents via a GitHub action, which could plausibly be set up to review PRs. None of this is documented as automatic code review on every pull request; it is mainly a human review workflow plus a general way to trigger agents. Missing for 10: documented automatic review triggered on every PR, agent-posted contextual review comments on PRs, configuration docs for review behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
